qAndA.answer: A sense of urgency and excitement. It highlights the problem of limited time but then positions Compass UOL's AI as a solution to reclaim and maximize that time.

activities.description: Alarm clock rings, a hand reaches to stop it.
Young boy's face transitions to an older woman's face.
Newton's cradle swings.
Time-lapse of the sun setting/rising.
Silhouette of a father lifting his child in front of a full moon.
Abstract transitions with geometric shapes and a full moon.
Dominoes with clock faces and days of the week fall in a circle.
The word 'TIME' is formed vertically with letters.
The words 'TICK' and 'TOCK' appear as the 'TIME' letters shift.
A microwave oven bursts into flames.
